svg.title: How math becomes a frame in Proof Engine
svg.desc: Four stages of one frame of the lorenz example. 1, the math: every frame the CPU advances 40,000 Lorenz states with the RK4 integrator. 2, glyphs: each state becomes one glyph instance, placed by projecting x and z, coloured and made emissive by its speed, and all of them go to the GPU in one instanced draw call. 3, light: the glyph pass writes colour and emission into a half-float HDR buffer where overlaps add up, 55 percent of the last frame is kept for trails, and the emission is blurred down and up a bloom pyramid. 4, the frame: the composite applies exposure, the ACES tonemap and a vignette, then the HUD text is painted sharp on top and the result goes to the screen or to a BMP file.
svg.text: One frame of the lorenz example, the way the engine draws it, every frame.
